facts.business: Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited manufactures, exports, and distributes steel pipes and tubes including ERW pipes, galvanized pipes, hollow sections, primer-painted pipes, crash barriers, and transmission line towers for infrastructure, construction, engineering, and industrial applications.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Section 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 and relevant details have been disclosed in the notes to the standalone financial statements.
